interface.longDescription:
Version 0.5.0-preview.2. Operator is the Codex plugin for Agent Operator Kit: a cockpit for real projects, including the V5 signed control graph, trusted host loop, scheduler, and session-based transient lanes. On the first Operator prompt it runs a read-only project preflight, distinguishes a workspace-shared plugin from a project-local runtime, and recommends the correct setup, repair, migration, or continuation path.

Use it to coordinate multiple feature chats, isolated worktrees, reusable lane roles, task packets, handoffs, memory, roadmap items, feedback intake, planning, design review, UX audits, journeys, and incubation. The source of truth stays explicit and project-local: operator.config.env, scripts/operator-*.sh, OPERATOR_DIR, feature sessions, lanes, memory, roadmap, graph state, and handoffs. Installing the plugin never copies private graph keys or another project's runtime state.
